item.title: 2025 People’s Choice: Best Listing—Nominations are Open!
item.description: The People’s Choice Best Listing Award is your chance to tell us about your absolute favorite listing of 2025! item.title: 1981 BMW 320i 5-Speed
item.description: This 1981 BMW 320i is finished in Chestnut Red Metallic over Parchment leatherette upholstery and shows 80k miles. Powered by a 1.8-liter M10 inline-four paired with a five-speed manual transmission, the car features include 13" turbine-spoke alloy wheels, front disc brakes, a sunroof, air conditioning, and a cassette stereo. Acquired by the selling dealer in 2025, this E21 is offered in North Carolina with a clean Carfax report and a clean Michigan title.

item.title: 2025 BaT Success Story of the Year—Nominations are Open!
item.description: BaT Success Stories highlight the experiences of both buyers and sellers, and so many of these pieces strike a chord with the BaT community. These tales are often filled with memories, new friendships, once-in-a-lifetime adventures, personal histories, and dreams come true. Last year our winner was joeinbcs, whose story told about the Eldorado sold for Honest John's charity. We published over 100 Success Stories in 2025, so there are plenty of great stories to choose from.

item.title: 2025 BaT Video of the Year—Nominations are Open!
item.description: Quality videos have become table stakes for BaT auctions, and are an integral part of almost every listing. But some transcend cold starts and interior functions, and wow our audience with impressive production values, and even narrative histories. Every year, the bar gets higher. item.title: 2025 BaT Photo Gallery of the Year—Nominations are Open!
item.description: Somehow, the photo galleries in BaT listings seem to get better every year, and it's easy to lose time perusing the hundreds of images that accompany many vehicles on the site. Talented photographers continue to up the ante, ensuring transparent presentation, while elevating vehicular imagery into art. Over 49,000 vehicles were listed on the site in 2025, and of those, this award salutes the galleries of the highest caliber.

item.title: It’s Time for the 2025 BaT Awards—Make Your Nominations Now!
item.description: You don't get a say in who wins the Super Bowl or the Oscars, and besides, those are over a month away. The annual BaT Awards are launching today, and your votes are the only ones that matter! Every January, we like to celebrate the highlights of the previous year on BaT with our annual awards. item.title: 5,900-Kilometer, Fuel-Injected 1988 Lamborghini Jalpa
item.description: This 1988 Lamborghini Jalpa is one of 410 built between 1981 and 1988, an estimated 100 of which were designated for the US market.
